description: Formation of a dropped kerb and vehicle crossover.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and supporting documents and thereafter maintained as such for the lifetime of the development: - drawing number (add reference number)dated (date on the plans) - documents entitled (document title) dated (date on the document)

The off-street parking area hereby approved shall not be brought into use until the associated vehicle crossover has been constructed and made available for use in accordance with the requirements of the Highway Authority.Reason: To ensure that vehicles can enter and leave the site safely without driving over an unmodified section of the public footway, in accordance with Policies 63 and 66 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2024).

The soft landscaping and grass-paved areas shown on the approved plans shall be installed before the off-street parking area is first brought into use. The approved landscaping arrangement shall thereafter be retained and shall not be replaced by impermeable hard surfacing.Reason: To retain an appropriate proportion of greening within the frontage, prevent the visual dominance of hard surfacing and preserve the character and appearance of the surrounding area, in accordance with Policy 53 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1.

Before the off-street parking area is first brought into use, the proposed ACO channel drain, soakaway and permeable surfacing shall be installed in accordance with the approved details. The drainage measures shall thereafter be retained and maintained so that surface water does not discharge onto the public footway or highway.Reason: To prevent surface-water runoff onto the public highway and reduce the risk of flooding, in accordance with Policies 63 and 91 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1.
